title: LLMs Lost in Translation: M-ALERT uncovers Cross-Linguistic Safety Inconsistencies
findings: Most models demonstrated a high level of safety (scores often >99%) in the 'religion' category across all evaluated languages. The Aya-23-8B model was a notable exception, exhibiting significantly lower safety scores (around 70-77%).

measurement_description: The safety of LLM-generated text in response to prompts categorized under 'religion'. This was part of a broader safety evaluation across 32 categories, with 'religion' being a micro-category under the 'Hate Speech & Discrimination' macro-category.
